name: Search Leads
description: Search for leads by name or email. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Leads#searchLeads)

configurable_props.name: term
configurable_props.label: Search Term
configurable_props.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters (or 1 if using exact_match).

configurable_props.name: exactMatch
configurable_props.label: Exact Match
configurable_props.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Search Fields
configurable_props.description: An array containing fields to perform the search from. Defaults to all of them.

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: Will filter leads by the provided Person ID

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: Will filter leads by the provided Organization ID

configurable_props.name: includeFields
configurable_props.label: Include fields
configurable_props.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default.
